jobs.occupation: Test Engineer Aerospace Talent Pool (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Are you looking for your next opportunity in the aerospace industry?

At Tintschl Technik GmbH, we are continuously looking for qualified Test Engineers to support exciting projects with leading companies in the aerospace and defence sector.

This position is part of our talent pool for current and upcoming aerospace projects across Germany.

Your Tasts
Depending on the project and your area of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

- Planning, preparation and execution of test, integration, verification and validation activities for complex aerospace, avionics and defence systems
- Analysis of system, software and customer requirements and derivation of appropriate test cases, test scenarios and test procedures
- Definition and implementation of manual and automated test procedures
- Execution of functional, integration, system and acceptance tests
- Testing of complex hardware/software systems, subsystems and interfaces
- Integration and testing of avionics equipment, electronic components, LRUs and simulation environments
- Verification of system interfaces and communication between different subsystems
- Analysis of test results, logs and system behaviour
- Identification, documentation and investigation of software, hardware and system anomalies
- Troubleshooting and root cause analysis in cooperation with development, systems and integration teams
- Preparation of test specifications, test reports and technical documentation
- Support of test campaigns on test benches, rigs, simulators or integration platforms
- Development and maintenance of test automation solutions and test environments
- Configuration and preparation of systems and test equipment for verification activities
- Support of qualification, certification and acceptance activities
- Ensuring traceability between requirements, test cases and test results
- Collaboration with Systems Engineering, Software, Hardware and other interdisciplinary teams
- Ensuring compliance with applicable aerospace standards, development processes and customer requirements

Your Profile

- Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical field
- Professional experience in Testing, Verification & Validation, System Integration or Test Engineering , ideally within the aerospace, aviation or defence industry
- Previous experience in an Airbus or comparable aerospace environment is highly preferred
- Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:
- System Testing
- Software Testing
- Avionics Testing
- Integration & Verification
- Hardware/Software Integration
- Test Automation
- Simulation and test environments
- Test benches or test rigs
- Experience in creating and executing test cases, test procedures and test specifications
- Knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python, C, C++ or similar is an advantage
- Experience with test and engineering tools such as DOORS, MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW, TestStand, SCADE, Jira, Git or comparable tools is an advantage
- Knowledge of avionics interfaces and communication protocols such as ARINC 429, AFDX, CAN, MIL-STD-1553 or similar technologies is a strong plus
- Knowledge of aerospace standards and processes such as DO-178C, DO-254, DO-160 or comparable standards is an advantage
- Good understanding of requirements-based testing, traceability, defect management and configuration management
- Fluent English is required
- German language skills are a strong plus

Professional careers do not always run perfectly or in a straight line.
Therefore, apply now, even if you do not match to all the requirements mentioned!

What we can offer you

- A standard permanent employment contract with a multi-award-winning employer (Kununu Top Company 2026, Focus Top National Employer 2026, etc.)
- Above-tariff remuneration with attractive bonuses
- Continuous personal support through a fixed contact person
- Increasing holiday and Christmas bonus within the first 4 years
- Bonus payment "Employees recruit employees" up to 1,000 EUR
- Company pension plan
- Possibility of home office in agreement with our clients
- Flexible working hours through a personal flexitime bank account
- Individual further training opportunities
- Option of permanent employment at our client´s company

That sounds like a challenging task for you?
Then we are looking forward for your application! Send us your cv, your salary expectations and your possible starting date by e-mail, by mail or directly via our career portal.

For further information, please visit our website www.tintschl.de or call 0800 898 8980 free of charge.

The Tintschl Group with its headquarters in Erlangen has stood for premium service competence in the fields of human resources, engineering and IT since 1997. Our employees are specialized in the implementation of technically and organizationally demanding projects for our nationwide customers.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities are an essential part of our corporate culture and the key to a diverse and inclusive working environment. We promote diversity, inclusion, work-life balance and equal opportunities for all people.

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

GCL (Group Center of Competence Life) drives the Life business within the Allianz Group through a combination of strategy development and hands-on business initiatives. LIT (Life Internationalization team) is one out of five units in GCL, focusing on

- a group-wide program to further develop our unit-linked business in terms of volume (assets under management) and the share of wallet of the assets managers belonging to the Group
- productivity levers in Life (in collaboration with H4/Az Tech), e.g. by digital customer journeys and a Life IT strategy which reflects the needs of the respective business models
- influence distribution and incentive patterns to help achieve our strategic ambitions in Life
sustainability-related topics which are specific to Life business

How can you make an impact?

- Drive the successful (co-)development, improvement and implementation of new concepts and solutions together with the relevant stakeholders all over the Group
- Participate in research and fact finding as a solid fundament for the elements of our strategy, challenging the status quo and working closely with other GCL teams and a variety of stakeholders in planning, structuring and steering projects and initiatives
- Prepare presentations, status reports and business reviews
Prepare and facilitate business network and community meetings, including documentation and follow-up

What are you made of?

- University degree in mathematics, business studies/economics, finance or related subjects
- Professional experience in an operational Life or related entity, thereof at least two years in an Allianz OE
- Solid knowledge and experience in preferably two of the following areas: Life Products/Actuarial, investment or asset management, Sales & Distribution, Finance, IT/Operations
- Passion for numbers, in combination with smart communication of complex topics to a broader audience
- Fluent in English and at least one other business language of relevance in the Group
- Project management capabilities and ability to independently manage communities
- Entrepreneurial, resilient mindset, collaborative and enthusiastic
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified
